description: This Java class defines a fragment for managing gesture-related settings in the AnySoftKeyboard app. It handles preference initialization, dialog setup, and UI interactions related to gesture configurations.

classes.name: GesturesSettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment for managing gesture-related preferences in the app.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Initializes preferences from XML and sets up the dialog controller.

methods.name: setupDialog
methods.description: Configures the alert dialog with title, message, and positive button.

methods.name: findPrefs
methods.description: Finds and returns a list of preferences corresponding to given keys.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up preference change listeners and updates UI based on current settings.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Removes preference change listeners to prevent leaks.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets activity title and updates preference states based on gesture typing enabled status.

methods.name: getAffectedPrefs
methods.description: Returns a list of preferences affected by gesture typing toggle.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Dismisses any active dialogs when the fragment stops.
